settings.checklists.title: Checklists
settings.checklists.intro: Opening, mid-shift and closing checklists for each store or for every store. Each save is a new version: the change shows in the staff app from the next run, with no app update, while past runs keep the wording of their version.
settings.checklists.demo: The demo has no staff app, so checklists are not edited here. Once a store uses the staff app on Zalo, this page edits the opening, mid-shift and closing checklists of each store.
settings.checklists.readOnly.role: The Checklists page is for owners and managers only.
settings.checklists.rowReadOnly: This checklist belongs to a store outside your scope or to every store; only an owner or a manager of every store can edit it.
settings.checklists.empty: No checklist yet. Press “New checklist”, then “Start from the outline” to begin from the steps of a shift.
settings.checklists.action.copyLabel: Copy the checklist {title} to another store
settings.checklists.form.storeHint: A checklist keeps its store and shift once created; copy it to use it at another store.
settings.checklists.form.fixed: {store} · {phase}. The store and shift stay as created.
settings.checklists.form.title: Checklist name
settings.checklists.form.items: Items, in the order they are done
settings.checklists.form.unitHint: For example °C or portions; at most {max} characters.
settings.checklists.form.skeletonHint: The outline fills in the steps of a shift: open the shift on the POS, hygiene, incidents, the waste tally, the handover and closing the shift on the POS. It works while there is no item yet; the owner approves the wording before use.
settings.checklists.form.nextRun: The change applies from the next run in the staff app; a run in progress and past runs keep the old version.
settings.checklists.form.itemsRequired: A checklist needs at least one item.
settings.checklists.form.itemsMax: A checklist has at most {max} items.
settings.checklists.form.control: Do not use control characters such as line breaks.
settings.checklists.copy.title: Copy {title}
settings.checklists.copy.hint: The copy is a new checklist at that store, with the same shift, name and items.
settings.checklists.done.saved: Saved version {version} of {title}; it applies from the next run.
settings.checklists.done.retired: Retired {title}; it is no longer due.
settings.checklists.error.scope: You edit only the checklists of the stores you manage; a checklist of every store needs an owner or a manager of every store.
settings.checklists.error.invalid: The checklist is not valid: check its name, items and units, then save again.
settings.checklists.skeleton.opening.pos: Open the shift on the POS and check the opening float
settings.checklists.skeleton.opening.hyg: Clean the counter and the drinks bar
settings.checklists.skeleton.opening.inc: Check the equipment; report any incident
settings.checklists.skeleton.opening.han: Read the previous shift's handover note
settings.checklists.skeleton.midshift.hy: Clean the counter and the tables
settings.checklists.skeleton.closing.was: Tally the waste of the shift
settings.checklists.skeleton.closing.hyg: Clean the drinks bar and the floor
settings.checklists.skeleton.closing.han: Write the handover note for the next shift
settings.checklists.skeleton.closing.pos: Close the shift on the POS and count the drawer
